810 likes, 82 comments - anahitadhondy on October 6, 2026: "Some people are simply the right people to have in the room. Puneeta was exactly that for the conversation around The Grain Kitchen🌾⭐️🌿

After two decades with Oberoi Hotels and Aman Resorts, 14 years as an organic farmer, and now as the founder and creator of Handpicked by PC and the DLF Artisanal Market, Puneeta has built a beautiful space for small-batch, natural, sustainable and chemical-free makers. The DLF Artisanal Market returns for its 8th season this October, continuing her work of bringing conscious producers and curious consumers together. 

So glad she was the one guiding this conversation around food, sustainability and grains!

Thank you @handpickedbypc for making this happen so effortlessly! See you soon at the market 💚

(The grain kitchen, Anahita Dhondy, Puneeta Chadha Khanna, Handpicked by PC, DLF Artisanal Market, The Green Trillion, organic farming, sustainable living, conscious food, natural food, chemical-free)".
